data.sql: WITH cell AS (SELECT CASE WHEN invoices.invoice_date >= '2011-01-01' AND invoices.invoice_date < '2011-02-01' THEN 'current' ELSE 'base' END AS period, SUM(invoice_lines.amount) AS value FROM invoice_lines LEFT JOIN invoices ON invoice_lines.invoice_no = invoices.invoice_no WHERE (invoices.invoice_type = 'return') AND ((invoices.invoice_date >= '2010-12-01' AND invoices.invoice_date < '2011-01-01') OR (invoices.invoice_date >= '2011-01-01' AND invoices.invoice_date < '2011-02-01')) GROUP BY 1) SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN period = 'base' THEN value END), 0) AS base_value, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN period = 'current' THEN value END), 0) AS current_value, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN period = 'current' THEN value END), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN period = 'base' THEN value END), 0) AS change FROM cell

evidence.sql: WITH cell AS (SELECT countries.market AS segment, CASE WHEN invoices.invoice_date >= '2011-01-01' AND invoices.invoice_date < '2011-02-01' THEN 'current' ELSE 'base' END AS period, SUM(invoice_lines.amount) AS value FROM invoice_lines LEFT JOIN invoices ON invoice_lines.invoice_no = invoices.invoice_no LEFT JOIN countries ON invoices.country = countries.country WHERE (invoices.invoice_type = 'return') AND ((invoices.invoice_date >= '2010-12-01' AND invoices.invoice_date < '2011-01-01') OR (invoices.invoice_date >= '2011-01-01' AND invoices.invoice_date < '2011-02-01')) GROUP BY 1, 2) SELECT segment, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN period = 'base' THEN value END), 0) AS base_value, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN period = 'current' THEN value END), 0) AS current_value, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN period = 'current' THEN value END), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN period = 'base' THEN value END), 0) AS change FROM cell GROUP BY segment ORDER BY ABS(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN period = 'current' THEN value END), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN period = 'base' THEN value END), 0)) DESC, segment

2011 年 1 月退货率为 13.65%，上个月是 2.26%，上升了 11.39 个百分点，相对变化为 +503.4%；退货额从 £17,547.86 增至 £91,525.05，而 GMV 从 £775,572.23 降到 £670,361.99。

几乎全部变化来自一张退货单据 C541433（2011-01-18 10:17，客户 10001，英国），单据金额 £77,183.60，对应商品 23166，这个商品的变化 100.0% 都来自这张单。它的贡献项变化为 +11.51 个百分点，占总变化的 101.1%，而它的预期份额是 0.0%，也就是说按正常情况不该有这么大的影响。

去掉这张单据后，本期退货率为 2.14%，总变化只有 −0.12 个百分点，说明其余业务的退货水平与上月基本持平，没有普遍恶化。

分析停在这一层，是因为这一个原因已解释了总变化的 101.1%，超过 80% 的阈值，无需继续下钻。建议业务方优先核实 C541433 是否为一次性的大额退货或录入异常，再判断 1 月退货率是否反映真实趋势。

data.text:
2010年5月GMV从£646,233.18降到£541,041.11，下降£105,192.07，相对变化为−16.3%。

主要原因是新客（首单当月）这一类客户的贡献大幅萎缩：其贡献项从基期的£122,829.49降到本期的£7,260.78，变化−£115,568.71，占总变化的109.9%，而按基期结构它的预期份额只有19.0%，明显高于正常波动范围57.0%以内的水平。

把这部分剔除之后，其余客户的GMV反而是增长的，总变化为+£10,376.64，也就是说老客户整体并没有拖累大盘。

分析停在这一层，是因为这一个原因已经解释了总变化的109.9%，超过了80%的停止线，无需继续往下拆。需要留意的是，问题集中在当月首次下单的新客上，后续可重点核对5月的拉新投放与新客转化是否出现了变化。
